title: CAPI scale-up simulation must preserve stable zone labels
answers: Why does Cluster API scale-up fail for pods requiring topology.kubernetes.io/zone?
Where are zone labels copied into CAPI template nodes?
How should scheduling labels be preserved in Cluster API scale-up simulation?
body:
Symptom: Cluster API scale-up does not trigger for pods requiring topology.kubernetes.io/zone.
Root cause: cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_nodegroup.go:extractNodeLabels copies a predefined label set; omitting the stable zone label deprived simulation templates of required topology metadata.
Fix pattern: Explicitly copy the stable zone label alongside the deprecated zone label, and verify source-to-template preservation in cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/clusterapi/clusterapi_nodegroup_test.go:TestNodeGroupTemplateNodeInfo.
Constraints: Applies to templates extracting labels from existing nodes; preserve nonempty source values through setLabelIfNotEmpty. This pattern does not provide zone metadata missing from the source node.
applies: Cluster API template-node label extraction for scale-up simulation.
